mapper.select: INSERT INTO db_contract_plan (plan_no, status, issue_count, executable_count, summary, created_by) VALUES (#{planNo}, N'DRAFT', #{issueCount}, #{executableCount}, #{summary}, #{createdBy}); SELECT CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO db_contract_plan_item (plan_id, violation_code, object_name, expected_value, actual_value, direction, action_text, executable, ddl_preview, execution_note, execution_status, verification_status) VALUES (#{planId}, #{item.violationCode}, #{item.objectName}, #{item.expectedValue}, #{item.actualValue}, #{item.direction}, #{item.actionText}, #{item.executable}, #{item.ddlPreview}, #{item.executionNote}, N'PENDING', N'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT TOP (100) id, plan_no, status, issue_count, executable_count, summary, created_by, created_at, approved_by, approved_at, approval_note, executed_by, executed_at, verified_at, failure_message, updated_at, row_version FROM db_contract_plan ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, plan_no, status, issue_count, executable_count, summary, created_by, created_at, approved_by, approved_at, approval_note, executed_by, executed_at, verified_at, failure_message, updated_at, row_version FROM db_contract_plan WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, plan_id, violation_code, object_name, expected_value, actual_value, direction, action_text, executable, ddl_preview, execution_note, execution_status, verification_status FROM db_contract_plan_item WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE db_contract_plan SET status = N'COMPLETED', verified_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = N'EXECUTING'
UPDATE db_contract_plan SET status = N'CANCELLED', updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (N'DRAFT', N'APPROVED') AND row_version = #{version}
UPDATE db_contract_plan_item SET execution_status = N'EXECUTED' WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND executable = 1
UPDATE db_contract_plan_item SET verification_status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
